review: No longer the King of Damage. N Sinclair requires planning and sanity management to properly utilize, but is not really hard to just drop into a team and winrate your way to victory. In Mirror Dungeons though his performance is severely hampered with the amount of higher level enemies in the dungeon, making it hard to maintain his Sanity and by extension, his damage. Outside from that, he works in pretty much all forms of content and can be put onto any team without any drawbacks. No Notable E.G.O. Synergies
